title: Exit load confusion
review_text: Redeemed my mutual fund and got less than the value shown in the app. Nobody told me about exit load. Where did the money go?

title: SIP failed no reason
review_text: My SIP failed twice this month with no clear reason and no proper message. Money was also not debited.

title: KYC stuck for days
review_text: KYC verification has been pending for 5 days. Support does not reply and there is no status update.

title: DP charge surprise
review_text: Sold a stock and got charged a DP charge even though the app says zero brokerage. This should be shown before selling.

title: Clean app but charges unclear
review_text: Nice clean app and easy to invest. The charges and fees section could be much clearer.

title: Exit load not shown before redeeming
review_text: There is no clear warning about exit load before I redeem. Very confusing for a new investor like me.

title: Withdrawal taking too long
review_text: Requested a withdrawal from my balance 4 days ago and it is still pending. No timeline given.

title: Statement download missing
review_text: I cannot find my capital gains statement or a simple monthly statement in the app.

title: Zero brokerage works
review_text: Investing is smooth and zero brokerage on delivery is genuinely good. Happy with the app.

title: Charged more than expected
review_text: When I redeemed, the credited amount was less than shown. Please explain exit load clearly in the app.

title: Auto-pay mandate failed
review_text: UPI auto-pay mandate failed and SIP did not go through. Received a generic error only.

title: Pan KYC mismatch
review_text: My PAN and KYC details did not match and the app gave no clear next step to fix it.

title: Why is money less
review_text: Why is my redemption amount less than the portfolio value? Is there a charge? Nothing is explained.

title: Good but hidden charges
review_text: Good platform overall but hidden charges reduce the trust. Please show all fees upfront.

title: Charts not loading
review_text: Portfolio charts and holdings are not loading since the last update. Have to reinstall often.

title: Refund not received
review_text: Payment was deducted for a SIP but units were not allotted and the refund is not received yet.

title: Nominee update fails
review_text: Trying to add a nominee but the form keeps failing. Not sure if my KYC is the issue.

title: Exit load hidden in fine print
review_text: Exit load is buried in the fine print. A first time investor will never notice it before redeeming.

title: Statements need work
review_text: Downloading reports is possible but the statements are hard to read and lack a simple summary.

title: Withdrawal charges unclear
review_text: Withdrawal from my trading balance took long and I am still unsure if any charges applied.

title: Amount credited less
review_text: Sold my mutual fund units and the credited amount was noticeably less. No explanation given for the deduction.

title: SIP date change confusing
review_text: Changing the SIP date is confusing and the next debit was still on the old date.

title: Smooth onboarding actually
review_text: Onboarding was smooth once KYC was approved. Verification took a while but worked.

title: No clear fee breakdown
review_text: There is no clear fee breakdown when I sell or redeem. You only find out after the money is credited.

title: Notifications unreliable
review_text: Price and order notifications are unreliable. I miss important updates on my holdings.

title: Capital gains report error
review_text: The capital gains report shows wrong numbers for last year. This is a serious problem for filing.

title: Exit load should be a warning
review_text: Before redeeming, the app should show a clear warning that exit load may apply. Right now it does not.

title: Fast support once reached
review_text: Support was helpful once I actually reached them, but reaching them takes too long.

title: Money stuck in payment
review_text: A payment went through but the order status is stuck on processing for two days.

title: AMC deducted without notice
review_text: An annual maintenance charge was deducted without any prior notice or email. Felt unexpected.

title: KYC re-verification loop
review_text: KYC re-verification keeps looping and asks for documents again and again.

title: Redemption but money late
review_text: Redeemed units three days back and money has still not reached my bank. No status shown.

title: Good for beginners
review_text: Good app for beginners. Would love a simple page that explains all fees in plain language.

title: Total amount less than shown
review_text: The redeem screen shows one amount but the bank credit is less. Very misleading for users.

title: Monthly statement hard to find
review_text: Getting a simple monthly statement is hard. Buried under too many menus.

title: SIP cancelled on its own
review_text: A SIP was cancelled automatically without informing me. This creates a lot of distrust.

title: Confused about deductions
review_text: I am genuinely confused about the deductions on redemption. The app needs to explain exit load in simple words.

title: Withdrawals improved
review_text: Withdrawals are a bit faster now. Still would prefer a clear status and charge note.

title: Fee page missing in app
review_text: There is no single fee page in the app where I can see all charges in one place.

title: Onboarding is fine now
review_text: Onboarding and KYC are fine now after the update. Earlier it was frustrating.
